'''Shengying''' is an NPC in {{location|Taoyuan Vale}} across the road from the Resonance Beacon.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Shengying:''' I lost again, ugh... I just can't beat her!
:{{DIcon}} Who?
:'''Shengying:''' Shh... Can't afford to let her hear my words... I'm talking about that courier, [[Pijin]]g.
:'''Shengying:''' The [[Kumu|boss]] asked me to rob [[Lollo Logistics]]' supplies, but I always run into her.
:'''Shengying:''' She could knock me out in just a couple of moves, easier than beating a [[Gulpuff]]! She's just too strong...
:{{DIcon}} Sounds like you admire her...
:'''Shengying:''' What are you talking about? Of course not! No one enjoy getting hit!
{{Dialogue End}}
